title: Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility
text:
Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility

["From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>\\nTo: Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>\\nCc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>\\nDate: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility\\n\\nHi Alicia,\\n\\nThanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation and clear alignment on where Redwood can lower inference costs for Starlite's care-coordination models. Per our chat, I wanted to put next steps in writing so we can get you through the AWS co-sell path (ACE) and into Marketplace listing discussion.\\n\\nHigh-level asks from our side:\\n- Confirm primary procurement contact + expected procurement timeline\\n- ACE registration: we'd like to register Starlite's pilot opportunity and bring in the AWS PDM/PSM for alignment\\n- Marketplace listing: quick intake to understand any security/compliance docs you'll need for procurement\\n\\nAttached: starlite-pricing-proposal.pdf (pricing sketch we ran during the demo).\\n\\nProposed next steps this week:\\n1) You loop in procurement and AWS PDM/PSM (if you want us to, we can request the PDM introduction)\\n2) We draft a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short checklist for ACE eligibility\\n3) Quick 30-min sync to align go/no-go and internal signoffs\\n\\nWould Wednesday or Thursday afternoon work for a call?\\n\\nThanks,\\n\\nTessa Morgan\\nEnterprise Sales\\nRedwood Inference\\n+1 (415) 555-0182\\n\\n---\\nAttachment: starlite-pricing-proposal.pdf (PDF, 420KB)\\n", "From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>\\nTo: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>\\nCc: procurement <procure@starlitehealth.com>, AWS ACE Team <pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com>\\nDate: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -0400\\nSubject: Re: Starlite Health — AWS co-sell & marketplace eligibility\\n\\nTessa — thanks for the follow-up and the pricing doc. Looping in our procurement team and the AWS ACE contact per your ask.\\n\\nA few quick notes from procurement:\\n- We typically need a draft SOW + brief on data handling and retention for vendor review (procure@starlitehealth.com).\\n- Targeting an internal decision by end of July, but we need PDM/PSM validation of co-sell path and any incentives.\\n\\nRajesh (cc'd) — can you confirm whether Starlite would be eligible for the ACE track based on a pilot opportunity and quick Marketplace listing? Also, please advise on PSM alignment for the pilot.\\n\\nIf helpful, we can share a short ROI template procurement prefers — otherwise, happy to use the pricing you shared.\\n\\nBest,\\nAlicia Gomez\\nHead of Partnerships\\nStarlite Health\\n---\\n", "From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>\\nTo: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@amazon.com>, AWS ACE Team <pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com>\\nCc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>\\nDate: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:45:00 -0700\\nSubject: Intro: Redwood <> AWS PDM/PSM + MAP (draft)\\n\\nRajesh — great to be connected. Per Alicia and Starlite's note, we're pursuing ACE registration for a pilot opportunity with Starlite. Quick background: Redwood provides a hosted inference runtime optimized for high-throughput clinical NLP and embeddings; Starlite is evaluating a pilot to reduce token costs and improve latency for their patient matching pipeline.\\n\\nKimberly (cc) is our Partner Ops lead who will own the MAP and Marketplace intake; Marcus (cc) is on our Solutions team for security/compliance questions.\\n\\nAttached: MAP-draft-v1.docx — a short mutual action plan to speed alignment. Key asks in the draft:\\n- Target pilot scope (2 models, ~5M tokens/month)\\n- Timeline: 6–8 week pilot to validation\\n- Security docs: SOC 2, data residency notes, logging cadence\\n\\nRequested next steps from AWS PDM/PSM:\\n1) Confirm ACE eligibility for co-sell runway and any incentives\\n2) Quick intro call (30 minutes) this week or next to triage Marketplace intake items\\n3) Confirm if any Marketplace packaging/partner onboarding items require pre-approval\\n\\nSuggested times: Thu 18:00–19:00 UTC or Fri 15:00–16:00 UTC. Happy to adjust.\\n\\nThanks — looking forward to moving this forward.\\n\\nTessa Morgan\\nEnterprise Sales\\nRedwood Inference\\n---\\nAttachment: MAP-draft-v1.docx (Word doc, 55KB)\\n", "From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@amazon.com>\\nTo: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>\\nCc: AWS ACE Team <pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com>, procurement <procure@starlitehealth.com>\\nDate: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 07:30:00 -07:00\\nSubject: Re: Intro: Redwood <> AWS PDM/PSM + MAP (draft)\\n\\nThanks for the context, Tessa and Alicia. Short answers up front:\\n- From the details provided, Starlite looks like a viable ACE candidate (pilot opportunity + clear enterprise intent).\\n- PSM alignment: we should include a PSM for pilot adoption and sales motion; I'll loop in the PSM separately.\\n\\nImmediate asks to get ACE registration started:\\n1) Confirm SOW skeleton or an agreed list of deliverables for the pilot (simple 1-pager is fine)\\n2) Procurement contact (procure@starlitehealth.com is fine) and an expected procurement window\\n3) Complete the ACE checklist — I attached the checklist PDF for reference.\\n\\nI can host a 30-minute triage at this time: Tue, Jun 24 16:00 UTC. Please confirm. Agenda: eligibility confirmation, PSM intro, Marketplace intake doc requirements.\\n\\nBest,\\nRajesh Kumar\\nPartner Development Manager — AWS ACE\\nAmazon Web Services\\n---\\nAttachment: aws-ace-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)\\n", "From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>\\nTo: Alicia Gomez <agomez@starlitehealth.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@amazon.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com>\\nCc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>, procurement <procure@starlitehealth.com>\\nDate: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -07:00\\nSubject: Re: Starlite Health — ACE follow-up & kickoff scheduling\\n\\nA quick follow from Redwood leadership: thanks, Rajesh — we confirm the Tue, Jun 24 16:00 UTC slot works and have invited our PSM counterpart internally. Pre-call asks from our side:\\n- Alicia/procurement: can you send the ROI template if you prefer to use it; otherwise the pricing proposal Tessa shared is fine.\\n- We'll bring a brief pilot SOW draft to the call to shorten the approval loop.\\n\\nLook forward to the triage and to mapping a runway for Marketplace listing post-pilot.\\n\\nLaura Bennett\\nHead of GTM Programs\\nRedwood Inference\\n---\\n(Invitation: Google Calendar event created for Tue, Jun 24 16:00 UTC)\\n"]
